title.orig: An Act Providing that Whenever the Phrase “Gonzales Type” Appears in All Items for Public Works Projects for the Second Congressional District of Negros Occidental in All Public Works Acts, the Same Shall Read “Ferrer Puwaki Type”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3598_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Whenever the phrase "Gonzales Type" appears in all items for public works projects for the Second Congressional District of Negros Occidental in all public works Acts the same shall read "Ferrer Puwaki Type."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
